collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — LUCK, OMENS AND LAVASTONES (LO-01 to LO-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A child holding a lavastone asks where they come from, and an adult has heard too many answers.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has been holding a lavastone, very carefully, while (friend) watches. "Where do they come from?" (subject.he/she) asks. "Does somebody make them? Do they grow? Did they fall from the sky?" (friend) opens (friend.his/her) mouth to answer, and realizes (friend.he/she) has heard at least five different answers in (friend.his/her) life, and doesn't know which one is true.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (friend) tells (subject) every answer (friend.he/she) has ever heard: they are the island's heat, cooled into stone. They are gifts from the spirits. They are what's left of the stars. They are just a kind of rock nobody has understood yet. (subject) listens to all of them very seriously. "Which one do you believe?" "Some days one, some days another." (subject) thinks this is a very sensible answer.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: "What do you think?" asks (friend). (subject) looks at the stone for a long time. "I think they come from somewhere warm," (subject.he/she) says. "And they're a bit lonely. So they like being held." (friend) can't argue with that. Nobody can. It might even be right.
